afa14ac549924a2d41a64f7342d8a2a16b9071fa.pinyin: qǐng zài biǎo gé xià fāng qiān míng.

afa2cc1b22f037d99bdc5827efff079178614891.pinyin: xīn xiū de shí gǒng qiáo gé wài yǐn rén zhǔ mù.
afa2cc1b22f037d99bdc5827efff079178614891.text: 新修的石拱桥格外引人瞩目。

afa2d16c4e766152dbfb98685c5f5c73e600b549.pinyin: nà zǔ yǒu liù gè zǔ yuán.

afaa9cd2cd54e6cac4f875f1fabbd56ae68ff3ff.pinyin: tā bǎ hùn luàn de qíng kuàng wěn dìng xià lai, jiǎn shǎo sǔn shī.
afaa9cd2cd54e6cac4f875f1fabbd56ae68ff3ff.text: 他把混乱的情况稳定下来，减少损失。

afadddb2399c3eab678262ca83cbfa62a1069e45.pinyin: tā yòng qián zi bá chū le mù bǎn shàng de dīng zi.
afadddb2399c3eab678262ca83cbfa62a1069e45.text: 他用钳子拔出了木板上的钉子。

afae5535392c2f36fffa2ae473443557059b2a88.pinyin: yī shēng jì lù le tā chōu chù de shí jiān.
afae5535392c2f36fffa2ae473443557059b2a88.text: 医生记录了他抽搐的时间。

afb20338262925c9b084021dfef85f7414126f54.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàng liàn shì tā shēng rì shí shōu dào de lǐ wù.
afb20338262925c9b084021dfef85f7414126f54.text: 这条项链是她生日时收到的礼物。

afb2078202368bebfdcd52291a5de6f619f150fe.pinyin: Zhù shì bǎ chì luǒ jiě shì wéi méi yǒu chuān yī fu.
afb2078202368bebfdcd52291a5de6f619f150fe.text: 注释把赤倮解释为没有穿衣服。

afb33a6a502e3277ff0e68fdc3a7920bec17b800.pinyin: shī rén yǐ fú fú miáo xiě mào shèng de shù lín.
afb33a6a502e3277ff0e68fdc3a7920bec17b800.text: 诗人以芾芾描写茂盛的树林。

afb40519f90243515cb65821df565edf61d2265b.pinyin: bǎi xìng pàn wàng gān gē zǎo rì zhǐ xī.
afb40519f90243515cb65821df565edf61d2265b.text: 百姓盼望干戈早日止息。

afb406c465b6c46af81b7a1da1943588582ce34c.pinyin: Zuò zhě yǐ huī fēi de xíng xiàng miáo xiě wū yán de qīng qiǎo.
afb406c465b6c46af81b7a1da1943588582ce34c.text: 作者以翚飞的形象描写屋檐的轻巧。

afb532a042894f89576fe55eba566e5ef1178b7e.pinyin: zhè ge chǔ wù guì xū yào sǎo mǎ dǎ kāi.
afb532a042894f89576fe55eba566e5ef1178b7e.text: 这个储物柜需要扫码打开。

afb7f53d1ec3cd7c20d1d38fe3956ceb6ffec45d.pinyin: tā men zhù zài jiǎn lòu de mù wū lǐ.
afb7f53d1ec3cd7c20d1d38fe3956ceb6ffec45d.text: 他们住在简陋的木屋里。

afbd89942f9cbf2b39ccd3af6b2e42f53caee02f.pinyin: Yǔ tíng hòu, nóng mín dào cài yuán lǐ pǎng dì.
afbd89942f9cbf2b39ccd3af6b2e42f53caee02f.text: 雨停后，农民到菜园里耪地。

afbf5e35968c80007d510fb38c5efca0c428f10f.pinyin: tā de huí dá yǔ shàng cì bié wú èr zhì.
afbf5e35968c80007d510fb38c5efca0c428f10f.text: 他的回答与上次别无二致。

afbfe4473c620d77d8e051c6b8003c7a60ce2c00.pinyin: tāng mǔ bǐ mǎ lì xiǎo sān suì.

afc0b39f8b076a040fa28775e3711d87897511f5.pinyin: miàn duì liǎng fèn gōng zuò yāo qǐng, tā yī shí jǔ qí bù dìng.
afc0b39f8b076a040fa28775e3711d87897511f5.text: 面对两份工作邀请，她一时举棋不定。

afc27f0f6f065e627686a3cbaceb7bd12519c285.pinyin: jì lǐ kāi shǐ shí, zhǔ jì zhě xiàng dì miàn lèi jiǔ.
afc27f0f6f065e627686a3cbaceb7bd12519c285.text: 祭礼开始时，主祭者向地面酹酒。

afc628ff88b8d0cd8316805462f6750aa78446db.pinyin: shī bài fǎn ér biān cè tā gèng jiā nǔ lì.
afc628ff88b8d0cd8316805462f6750aa78446db.text: 失败反而鞭策他更加努力。

afc680f26ac2f92e133f0ca15bfdf4acd8c131ab.pinyin: dēng jī qián yào jiǎn chá jī piào.

afc7b961098e5e9ee33df58f5bbfc5ab6af095d3.pinyin: zhè kuài pú yù hái dài zhe cū cāo de shí pí.
afc7b961098e5e9ee33df58f5bbfc5ab6af095d3.text: 这块璞玉还带着粗糙的石皮。

afc7c3ea2078fa894ea219e75c24c504feba613c.pinyin: yǎn yuán qiáo zhuāng dǎ bàn hòu zǒu shàng jiē tóu.
afc7c3ea2078fa894ea219e75c24c504feba613c.text: 演员乔装打扮后走上街头。

afc7cfb56cb2f42f984a2be3dcd7ee30ba753b56.pinyin: jiē dài kè rén shí, tā shàn yú chá yán guān sè.
afc7cfb56cb2f42f984a2be3dcd7ee30ba753b56.text: 接待客人时，她善于察言观色。

afc9c3cac9146ebb0f099544114267d830728d71.pinyin: tā niān xiàn shí hěn yǒu nài xīn.

afcaaf13631283c8b4db807adb8b821b79502368.pinyin: zhè shuāng xié tài xiǎo, wǒ xiǎng tuì huò.

afd7a6b82757c9b1714bf274c8f474e2e9a603a7.pinyin: wǒ hé tā men yì jiàn yī zhì.

afd7f5b4f01c8ba98413c35ff4595bf45b4214e7.pinyin: méi yǒu gōng zuò yòu bù yuàn móu shēng, tā zhǐ néng dān xīn hē xī běi fēng.
afd7f5b4f01c8ba98413c35ff4595bf45b4214e7.text: 没有工作又不愿谋生，他只能担心喝西北风。

afd82a04ec9c05aeed4d61f96e5b47dcb0948680.pinyin: tā yòng yí gè dié zi chéng shuǐ guǒ.

afda54bcb94d115667fd8c62797db4d3e8d75f58.pinyin: lǎo shī yòng mó xíng jiǎng jiě sāi xiàn yǔ kǒu qiāng de wèi zhì guān xi.
afda54bcb94d115667fd8c62797db4d3e8d75f58.text: 老师用模型讲解腮腺与口腔的位置关系。

afdb0eba0bcd0342a6181c02c2a5acc03781f2bb.pinyin: xùn liàn yào zhú bù zēng jiā qiáng dù, bù néng cāo zhī guò jí.
afdb0eba0bcd0342a6181c02c2a5acc03781f2bb.text: 训练要逐步增加强度，不能操之过急。

afde9e778446540b7ffe2be968d47ced0c4ffd55.pinyin: gǔ shū bǎ huǒ bǎ chēng zuò jué jù.

afdef2dadc6db867561743dfcb9659b430bad279.pinyin: tú zhōng xiǎn shì máo yòu de xíng tài.

afe187f7522eb2b8ef867d1ec262227107c60730.pinyin: yī míng wěi dà de zhàn shì wēi lì xiǎn zhù, wú xū dǐ sǐ fèn zhàn.
afe187f7522eb2b8ef867d1ec262227107c60730.text: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。

afe383b2a96bb19208f6de01a2b43009bdb96c5e.pinyin: shuǐ wèi jí jù shàng shēng, tā jù rán yì jīng.
afe383b2a96bb19208f6de01a2b43009bdb96c5e.text: 水位急遽上升，他瞿然一惊。

afe4354c58486c959fc759833c08378b8ef21ec9.pinyin: hé shuǐ shí shí, wǒ men kàn de jiàn shuǐ dǐ shí tou.
afe4354c58486c959fc759833c08378b8ef21ec9.text: 河水湜湜，我们看得见水底石头。

afe74d19190c3cd48a5a128602a81f7192af26d4.pinyin: zhè zūn pú sà xiàng de miàn róng shí fēn ān xiáng.
afe74d19190c3cd48a5a128602a81f7192af26d4.text: 这尊菩萨像的面容十分安详。

afe78974c2f0641b06065892e13965553490a18b.pinyin: yé ye dǎ kāi xiāng zhì, fān kàn bǎo cún duō nián de jiù shū.
afe78974c2f0641b06065892e13965553490a18b.text: 爷爷打开缃帙，翻看保存多年的旧书。

afe9a359bd0b377d7e2103d05cb6f6c3ebcf56e1.pinyin: fāng cái yǒu rén lái zhǎo guò nǐ.

afe9ceae70a29020a2a9719370ee46496be890f4.pinyin: zhè fèn shuō míng shū tí dào le xiān qì dēng.
afe9ceae70a29020a2a9719370ee46496be890f4.text: 这份说明书提到了氙气灯。

afef9e66d71cb7b231b2fc94d6bbd29e40930221.pinyin: tā yòng hēi sè mò shuǐ xiě le yì fēng xìn.
afef9e66d71cb7b231b2fc94d6bbd29e40930221.text: 她用黑色墨水写了一封信。

aff147fe410133cafe2c0bb64fbb0d33f2d2d113.pinyin: tuó lóng duǒ zài shuǐ lǐ, zhǐ lù chū yī shuāng yǎn jīng.
aff147fe410133cafe2c0bb64fbb0d33f2d2d113.text: 鼍龙躲在水里，只露出一双眼睛。

aff61795b447c4790e0d29ea27176a0a38ed2c8a.pinyin: tā de biǎo yǎn qīng xīn zì rán, rú chū shuǐ fú róng.
aff61795b447c4790e0d29ea27176a0a38ed2c8a.text: 她的表演清新自然，如出水芙蓉。

aff82eb518d8418df8dd1a3d20fdca3c50979949.pinyin: nǐ zhī dào zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de shén me?
aff82eb518d8418df8dd1a3d20fdca3c50979949.text: 你知道中央情报局的什幺？

aff8a99ab8a8a64355d24ee6dac80920923abb32.pinyin: zhè ge xiǎo píng mù zhǐ yǒu sān yīng cùn kuān.
aff8a99ab8a8a64355d24ee6dac80920923abb32.text: 这个小屏幕只有三英寸宽。

aff948f10bb57668f73b28078a3c19c491db0682.pinyin: shī rén xiě xià lù shuǐ, miáo huì qīng chè de xī liú.
aff948f10bb57668f73b28078a3c19c491db0682.text: 诗人写下渌水，描绘清澈的溪流。

affa53d4cab44d6d9efb49b17ad93df0c6611c98.pinyin: zhè ge kàn rè nao de rén chà diǎn bǎ xiāo fáng chē de lù dǎng zhù le.
affa53d4cab44d6d9efb49b17ad93df0c6611c98.text: 这个看热闹的人差点把消防车的路挡住了。

affba09560c979a275fb2bdb9b0bbc1123612f7e.pinyin: xìng zi lǐ miàn yǒu yí ge yìng hé.

affba796e19c5c4e270ec22bd2fb2101d005e5bc.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ tīng guo zuì huāng miù de xiǎng fǎ.
affba796e19c5c4e270ec22bd2fb2101d005e5bc.text: 这是我听过最荒谬的想法。
